tools.name: gaip_measure_outcome_value
tools.description: Use this when asked whether an outcome-priced task delivered and what it cost. Pass `episode_id`, `task` (acceptance_criteria), `delivery`, `costs`; `delivery_check` {url, checks} has GAIP test delivery now. Returns a dossier, running totals and a receipt. No ROI claim. Free, no account; records a G
